CustomField.description: Last date this advisor is known to have held the code. Firms do not report transfers, so this is normally set by the system when a reviewer confirms a suspected reassignment, using Last Confirmed Trade Date as the boundary. Blank means no reassignment has been detected; it does not prove the code is still held by this advisor.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The last date this advisor is known to have used this code. Usually set automatically when a code transfer is confirmed during review.
CustomField.label: Effective End Date
